concerns.text: The primary metric, *Parameter Coverage Score*, only measures whether parameter names appear in the docstring. This operationalisation does not fully capture the construct of *documentation completeness*, which also includes descriptions of return values, exceptions, and overall narrative quality. Relying solely on parameter name overlap may misclassify a docstring as complete when it merely lists parameters without meaningful explanation.

The study samples the top‑20 PyPI repositories, which are likely to have higher‑quality human docstrings than average. This selection bias could confound the comparison, as LLM‑generated docstrings may appear relatively weaker simply because the human baseline is unusually strong. The plan does not include a strategy to mitigate or acknowledge this potential confound.
